title: 琥珀の砂塵と、真珠の円舞曲
author: 蘭 マリア

en.title: Amber Dust and the Pearl Waltz
en.premise: Solis, the sleepless city encircled by golden deserts. It is a paradise of opulent nobility, bathed in the ethereal blue light of a miraculous oasis. Yet, beneath the brilliance lies a vortex of blood-stained conspiracies and power struggles over a dwindling water source. A fallen noblewoman toyed with by fate, a genius jeweler, and a mysterious spy—as the curtain rises on a glamorous ball, these three will set the gears of history spinning astray.

zh.title: 琥珀之砂尘与珍珠圆舞曲
zh.premise: 被黄金沙漠环绕的不夜城——索利斯。这里是沐浴在奇迹绿洲之青光中的贵族乐园，尽显奢靡。然而，在光辉的背后，围绕着日益枯竭的水源，权力斗争与血腥阴谋正暗流涌动。被命运捉弄的没落千金、天才宝石工匠，以及一名神秘的密探。当华丽的舞会拉开帷幕之时，三人的出现将令历史的齿轮开始失控。
